fire_reset_rule: The environment executes FIRE at the initial serve and immediately after each observed life loss; it reports requested and executed actions.

decision.reason: FIRE assist changed all 15 diagnostic episodes from the v1 timeout pattern to terminated episodes while retaining greedy inference; epsilon=0.05 was retained as a diagnostic and not selected as the contract.

day16_reuse_rule: Vectorized training must use this same environment construction, serve semantics, termination semantics, concrete seeds, epsilon, and raw reward rule.
